title: One source, three agents
lede: A structural view of this repository’s direct skill installation and packaging.

nodes.label: Skill catalog
nodes.detail: Canonical skills/<name>/ folders in the local repository.

nodes.label: Catalog validator
nodes.detail: scripts/skills.py check validates names, metadata and packaged paths.

nodes.label: Skill ZIPs
nodes.detail: scripts/skills.py build creates reproducible ZIPs plus checksums.

nodes.label: Safe installer
nodes.detail: Preflights destination conflicts and managed hashes before copying resources. It does not execute skill scripts.

nodes.label: Codex skills
nodes.detail: User-level .agents/skills/<name>/ destination. File installation does not prove discovery.

nodes.label: Cursor skills
nodes.detail: User-level .cursor/skills/<name>/ destination. Skills remain independent copies.

nodes.label: Claude Code skills
nodes.detail: User-level .claude/skills/<name>/ destination. Local edits block managed updates.

edges.label: reads
edges.detail: The validator depends on the canonical skill catalog.

edges.label: built from
edges.detail: ZIPs are built from validated catalog content.

edges.label: reads catalog
edges.detail: The installer validates and snapshots selected catalog entries.

edges.label: installed by
edges.detail: The installer copies selected skills into the Codex user destination.

edges.label: installed by
edges.detail: The same canonical source is copied into the Cursor destination.

edges.label: installed by
edges.detail: The same canonical source is copied into the Claude Code destination.

steps.title: Start from the canonical catalog
steps.body: Public skills are folders in Git. Private experiments live elsewhere.

steps.title: Validate before copying
steps.body: The checker validates the restricted metadata and resource paths.

steps.title: Preflight installation
steps.body: The installer snapshots the selected sources and rejects conflicting or locally edited destinations.

steps.title: Copy to the chosen agents
steps.body: These user-level destinations receive independent copies. This diagram is a dependency view, not message direction or proof of agent discovery.

steps.title: Read the canonical catalog
steps.body: The ZIP builder reads public skill resources from the catalog.

steps.title: Produce reproducible archives
steps.body: A checksum catalog and complete per-skill ZIPs are local outputs. Publishing a release is a separate action.

assumptions: Derived from the local scripts/skills.py and Makefile implementation; hosted main may differ until this branch is published.
Dashed dependency arrows point from the dependent component to its supplier, not in the direction of file transfer.
Boxes group responsibilities rather than deployed services. The catalog is local Git content; no MCP or API server participates.
The diagram abstracts staging, ownership receipts and rollback details. It does not imply runtime agent integration was tested.
evidence: Evidence: inspected local scripts/skills.py, Makefile and DETAILS.md. Structural simplification.
